question: Which day has Bangladesh declared as National Martyred Army Day?
solution:
The correct answer is February 25

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• The **Bangladesh government declared February 25 as National Martyred Army Day** to commemorate the 2009 **BDR mutiny**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Cabinet Division issued a gazette notification** on this decision on Sunday.
 
• The **BDR mutiny, also called the Pilkhana tragedy, occurred on February 25-26, 2009**, in Dhaka.
 
• A **faction of the BDR staged the rebellion**, leading to the **killing of 74 people, including 57 army officers**.
 
• The **BDR (Bangladesh Rifles) was a paramilitary force responsible for border security**.
 
• The **mutiny caused national shock and had long-lasting consequences** on Bangladesh’s security framework.
 
• The government **classified February 25 as a "Category C" day**, meaning **there will be no public holiday** on this observance.
